newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil minister toasts weekly export performance.
newsitem.headline: Brazil minister toasts weekly export performance.

text.p: A strong performance by Brazilian exports in the fourth week of October shows that fears of a ballooning trade deficit are unfounded, Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles said.
"The trade balance in October and for the year will be better than the market has been predicting," Dornelles told reporters.
Earlier on Tuesday, the Industry and Commerce Ministry announced that exports during October's fourth week totalled $1.123 billion with a daily average of $224.16 million.

That contrasted with exports of $844 million in October's third week, a poor performance which prompted analysts to estimate a monthly trade deficit of between $800 million and $1.5 billion and put pressure on Brazilian debt.
"Today's numbers point towards an improvement," Dornelles said.
